title: Sharp Decision Curves and Cutoff Regret with an Imperfect Reference Standard
banked_reason: Banked downgraded on 2026-09-09 during Lean formalization: the derivation had passed review at field tier, but the cold D0.5.G re-score under the projected-paper-score rule gave 7.4 and tier subfield, and the run was banked on that tier; the run did not fail and is a re-raise candidate.
tldr: Under exact transport of reference sensitivity and specificity, positive Youden orientation, and interior recovered prevalence, every compatible population law is represented by observed-measure-dominated disease submeasures, giving sharp joint score-wide curves and an exact deterministic-cutoff regret formula for arbitrary Borel score laws. The finite-support population scan remains an \(O(m)\) four-mask monotone-deque algorithm after sorting. For inference, no finite score alphabet is required: any prespecified cutoff class with finitely many distinct policies generates a finite Borel partition, and one common cutoff-atom primitive confidence set yields simultaneous regret envelopes and inner--outer robust-cutoff sets with finite-sample coverage. The finite sign--comparator graph is computed by finitely many linear programs at fixed reference accuracies and finitely many semialgebraic problems for interval-valued accuracies, with complexity indexed by the number of policy atoms and cutoffs. Numerical inference for an unrestricted continuum of cutoffs, realistic-sample nonvacuity, contact-adaptive efficiency, and an independent software implementation audit remain open.
gap: Existing unrestricted-dependence bounds treat one binary index test, whereas full-ROC methods and ordinary decision-curve bands either impose conditional independence or observe disease. Within the exact-transport, positive-Youden, compatibility-interior model, none of the inspected work gives the exact common-law regret of every cutoff or an exact whole-curve algorithm.
fill: The dominated-submeasure representation yields sharp joint curves, interval-specific contrast capacities, the exact regret functional, a constructive nonrectangularity witness, an \(O(m)\) scan, and optimizer-set coverage that includes ties and active-face changes.
